<header class="page-heading">
  <p class="eyebrow">District Court starter template</p>
  <h1>Response or Opposition to Motion</h1>
  <p>Use this structure to respond to a pending motion and identify the disposition you ask the Court to enter.</p>
</header>

<article class="filing-template">
  <p class="filing-template__notice"><strong>Template use.</strong> Replace bracketed text with case-specific information. Address the actual motion and applicable court rules rather than treating this outline as substantive argument.</p>
  <div class="filing-template__document">
    <div class="filing-template__caption"><p><strong>UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT</strong></p><p><strong>DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA</strong></p><h2>[CASE CAPTION]</h2><p>Case No. [DOCKET NUMBER]</p></div>
    <h2>[PARTY]’S [RESPONSE / OPPOSITION] TO [MOTION TITLE]</h2>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Motion addressed</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Title and filing date / docket entry]</span></div>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Requested disposition</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Grant, deny, grant in part, or other requested action]</span></div>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Position</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Briefly state the responding party’s position.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Argument</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Respond to the motion’s grounds in a logical order, with authorities where applicable.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Conclusion</h3><p class="template-placeholder">For these reasons, [party] respectfully requests that the Court [requested disposition].</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Respectfully submitted</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Name]<br>[Title / counsel status]<br>[Date]</p></section>
  </div>
</article>
